_about: The No button can never be pressed. Every tap draws a random move from the current tier. Moves inside a tier are shuffled and do not repeat until the tier runs dry, then the tier reshuffles. The deck gets wilder the longer the guest fights.

yes_growth.note: Yes grows a little with every No tap, up to the cap, so the whole screen leans one way.

idle.note: After the first tap, if the screen sits still for a random 4 to 9 seconds, No sometimes fidgets or drifts on its own. Never before the first tap, so the screen looks normal at first glance.

avoid: the point that was just tapped

moves.does: Jumps to a random safe spot with a small overshoot and settle.
Shrinks to half size on the spot, then slowly grows back.
Scoots along to the nearest screen edge as if escaping, then rests there.
Its label flips to Yes for about a second, then back to No.
Ducks behind the Yes button, then peeks out from one side.
Splits into three tiny buttons that each say Wrong one, then they merge back into No at a new spot.
Label becomes Processing your No..., then Error: No not found, then back to No.
Drops to the bottom of the card and bounces twice.
Turns grey, a small sweat drop appears, label reads Abeg, I'm tired, then it recovers.
The whole card shakes, No falls off the bottom edge and climbs back up from below.
A gold YES stamp slams down on top of No, then lifts away.
No walks off screen. A small system line reads No has left the chat. After 3 to 6 seconds it returns, or on the next tap it reappears somewhere new.

lines._about: One line appears under the buttons after each tap, drawn at random without repeating the last three.
tier_1: Are you sure that's the button you wanted?
tier_2: Everybody wey matter go dey there.
We can do this all day.
The Yes button is right there, you know.
tier_3: Na only Yes dey this menu.
At this point, it's a sport.
You're on the Resistance Board now.

haptics.note: navigator.vibrate where supported. Silent on iPhone, which is fine.

reduced_motion.behaviour: No stays in place. Each tap only swaps its label and the line under the buttons.

screen_reader.on_activate_announce: Nice try. Only Yes is available.

tracking.store: no_taps on the invite, incremented on the server (debounced, at most one write per 400 ms, batched)
